name: Krusch Agentic Proxy MCP
description: Dual-Engine (Thinker + Implementer) MCP server and local LLM tool-calling gateway with tokenized shlex command allowlists and sensitive dotfile isolation. Task delegation via krusch_execute_task and unknown tools require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep krusch_execute_task on Review: although internal tools enforce tokenized shlex allowlists and block sensitive dotfiles (.env, .ssh, .aws), the sub-agent runs local inspection commands.
Set KRUSCH_ALLOWED_ROOTS to a colon-separated list of project directories instead of relying on the default home and /tmp roots.
Lower max_loops (or set KRUSCH_AGENT_TIMEOUT) when delegating narrow inspection tasks so sub-agent iterations stay tightly bounded.
